key_decisions.decision: Pinned elem silence difficult; preserve without silently repointing gods or rulers, note alternatives.
Keep hyperbolic birth accusation, not convert into doctrinal explanation.
Keep ancient deaf-snake image even though biological description is not modern science.
Keep both violent commands and lion metaphor.
Follow read plural arrows, preserve singular subject shift and difficult cut-off image.
Retain disturbing snail and stillbirth comparison without euphemism; note poetry not judgment on bereaved.
Retain difficult pots/thorns/wind sequence; green/burning interpretive choice disclosed.
Preserve delight in vengeance and blood; use collective English for the generic righteous and wicked figures.
Keep fruit image and doubled indeed, plural participle construed with God.
